text: I have heard from residents of Boulton Avenue that are having trouble with their driveway, which services multiple houses, being constantly blocked by parked cars. Creating an area of specific no-parking in front of the driveway would not remove an on-street parking space, but would allow for more visible signage that would help cut down on illegally parked cars. I hope you'll support this recommendation.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Prohibited parking at all times on the west side of Boulton Avenue, between a point 30.1 metres north of Clark Street and a point 6.8 metres further north.
